title: polystichum lineare
intro: Polystichum lineare, commonly known as the Chinese fern or maidenhair spleenwort, is a type of evergreen fern native to East Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving respiratory health. The therapeutic actions of Polystichum lineare include anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of bronchitis and other respiratory conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
